diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_member.additive grants roles from var.iam_additive_roles, which may reference custom roles created by google_project_iam_custom_role.roles in this module (role IDs like "projects/<id>/roles/<name>"). Applying the IAM member before the custom role exists fails ("role not found"). The sibling resource google_project_iam_binding.authoritative explicitly depends_on google_project_iam_custom_role.roles for exactly this reason; the additive member has neither an attribute reference nor a depends_on, so Terraform may create the IAM member first.

google_project_iam_member.additive should not be applied before the project's service APIs are enabled: GCP API enablement is asynchronous, and service-scoped roles (e.g. compute, dataproc, pubsub roles) may not be grantable until the corresponding google_project_service.project_services entries are active. The module already encodes this ordering for google_project_iam_binding.authoritative via depends_on, but the additive member has no such dependency.
